name: 25302 · Charleston, WV
findings: ZIP 25302 (Charleston) has 83 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 25302 (Charleston) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 25302 (Charleston) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 29 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.
